test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

POLE : SROH :: HAIR : ?
solution:
The positional value of the English alphabet is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

The pattern follows here is : 

1) POLE: SROH 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/762a0a920ddcbb163f41d63f1cb1319def836d78327c30d837e65f47e64d7d7c.png] 

Similarly,

2) HAIR : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c60f880785a57e6373f0e1b52c8c63b03adefa35141ad10d31360cfbc18bdc6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"KDLU".**
